steps.command: git status --short && rg --files tests larder && rg -n 'can_cancel|cancel' tests

python3 -m pytest -q && python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from larder.cancellation import can_cancel

pickup = datetime(2026, 10, 30, 12)
cutoff = pickup - timedelta(hours=2)
assert can_cancel(pickup, cutoff - timedelta(microseconds=1))
assert can_cancel(pickup, cutoff)
assert not can_cancel(pickup, cutoff + timedelta(microseconds=1))
assert not can_cancel(pickup, pickup)
print('Cancellation cutoff boundary checks passed.')
PY
